item.title: Iran's supreme leader severely disfigured by US strikes: report
item.summary: Iranian supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei is severely disfigured after U.S.-Israel airstrikes on Tehran killed his father, according to a Reuters report citing anonymous sources.

item.title: John Cleese blasts world's silence on Easter massacre of Nigerian Christians by Islamist terrorists
item.summary: Monty Python's John Cleese blasts the political landscape for failing to condemn radical Islam after reported Easter attacks on Nigerian Christians.

item.title: ICE detains relatives of 1979 Iran hostage crisis figure after Rubio revokes their legal status
item.summary: Secretary of State Rubio says he revoked green cards for family members linked to 1979 Iran hostage crisis spokeswoman known as 'Screaming Mary.'

item.title: Trump blasts Spanberger ahead of Virginia meetings, says state faces tax base exodus like New York, California
item.summary: President Donald Trump blasts Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger over taxes, warning her policies could drive people and companies out like what's happening in New York and California.

item.title: Machete-wielding suspect claiming to be 'Lucifer' shot by police after allegedly stabbing 3 at transit hub
item.summary: A machete-wielding man claiming to be Lucifer attacked three people at Grand Central Terminal before NYPD officers fatally shot him, police say.

item.title: ‘Charlie’s Angels’ star Cheryl Ladd defied producers with ‘tiniest bikini ever’ to make her point
item.summary: Cheryl Ladd says she bought the tiniest bikini to defy producer Aaron Spelling's wardrobe choices on the set of the iconic series "Charlie's Angels."

item.title: Minnesota fraud suspect skips court, forfeits bond, throwing $11M Medicaid case into doubt
item.summary: A man accused of defrauding Minnesota's Medicaid program of nearly $11 million skipped a court hearing, forfeiting his bond and triggering a warrant.

item.title: Friend of Brian Hooker speaks out, questions disappearance of woman in Bahamas mystery
item.summary: Seasoned boater and friend Daniel Danforth says Brian Hooker's story about wife Lynette's disappearance during a Bahamas trip doesn't add up.

item.title: New Zealand cyclist Kiaan Watts suspended after punching rival rider mid-race
item.summary: Cyclist Kiaan Watts was suspended 25 days after video captured him punching fellow rider Marijn Maas during the Ster van Zwolle race in the Netherlands last month.

item.title: Bill Maher defends Western civilization on ‘Real Time,’ citing remarks from JD Vance
item.summary: On Real Time, Bill Maher discusses JD Vance's Hungary trip, Orbán's ties to Russia and the debate over defending Western civilization values.
